title: Temporal astrocytic metabolic reprogramming gates pain chronification
title_zh: 时序星形胶质细胞代谢重编程调控疼痛慢性化
abstract: Most experimental models of chronic pain emphasize the gradual emergence of sensory hypersensitivity, yet pain chronification can also be conceptualized as a metabolically regulated state transition. In this review, we synthesize evidence mainly from mouse and rat spinal cord and anterior cingulate cortex studies indicating that astrocytes temporally coordinate neuronal excitability, inflammatory signaling, and metabolic coupling. We propose that chronification proceeds through temporally organized astrocytic metabolic remodeling: GPCR-linked lactate-coupled signaling during acute induction, sustained glycolytic gene expression and glycogen remodeling during consolidation, and stabilization of pain-permissive astrocyte states through lactylation-linked inflammatory and chromatin regulation. By integrating these mechanisms along a temporal axis, this framework distinguishes processes that initiate chronicity from those that maintain established pain and suggests stage-specific logic for future interventions.
abstract_zh: 大多数慢性疼痛实验模型强调感觉过敏的逐步出现，但疼痛慢性化也可被视为一种由代谢调控的状态转变。在本综述中，我们综合了主要来自小鼠和大鼠脊髓及前扣带皮层的研究证据，表明星形胶质细胞在时间上协调神经元兴奋性、炎症信号和代谢耦合。我们提出，慢性化通过时序化的星形胶质细胞代谢重塑进行：急性诱导期间的GPCR‑联乳酸耦合信号、巩固阶段的持续糖酵解基因表达与糖原重塑，以及通过乳酰化相关的炎症和染色质调控稳定疼痛促发的星形胶质细胞状态。通过沿时间轴整合这些机制，该框架区分了启动慢性化的过程与维持已建立疼痛的过程，并为未来干预提供了阶段性逻辑。
